svg.title: CASTAWAY: six lanes of glossy plumbing, one loop of the theme
svg.desc: A black screensaver panel in which glossy pipes in six colours grow through 3D space one segment per sixteenth note, turning at right angles with ball joints and elbows and passing in front of and behind each other. The title CASTAWAY is built from ivory pipes with ball fittings, and a small woman in cream headphones, a coral tank top and cream shorts sits on the second A, nodding to the beat. Under it: a ten-hour lo-fi island video; she idles, nodding to the music; every so often something happens, always on the next bar. Legend: one pipe per lane: her, sea and sky, turtle, cat, shore, kumara. After nineteen bars the pipes dissolve in black blocks and start again. One ball joint per loop is a coconut.
